Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01N2EvxDPjdoFBFtyygdYP4j

Styles of card play: a directed preference among the cards a bot rates as close (bridge_harness/style.py)

Max, 03:35 to 03:46 UTC on 14 November: more variability in the opponent population, mostly directed (a variety of styles),
a little of it random; the exact dimensions do not matter, only that a bot is not read beyond bridge logic. A style is
{'tempo' | 'active' | 'high': weight, 'random': share}: tempo (take the trick now / cash a winner, against duck and wait),
active (a new suit, a lead from under an honour, against the safe continuation), high (rank). gen7 `style`: a search bot
keeps, of the cards within its `near_tie`, the ones its style prefers, and its tie-break chooses among those. x8
`mix.style`: the same for a rollout bot's near-equal candidates (`mix.near`). Bots without a style are unchanged and pin
what they pinned.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01N2EvxDPjdoFBFtyygdYP4j

Stu: split-seat, blind and blind-split bots (stu3-px, stu3-pu, stu3-pux) and their jobs

Max, 03:12 to 03:28 UTC on 14 November. -px: its own side's simulated seats drawn among the cards at least half as likely as
the likeliest, the other side's among those at least a quarter as likely. -pu: told nothing about who sits against it (the
simulated opponents are the net's unknown player and are told nothing about this bot; their cards read at the weight of an
opponent never met and as a side that may play any equal card). -pux: both, and its defenders play a random one of their
equal cards ("For now random").

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01N2EvxDPjdoFBFtyygdYP4j

8X seats by side, a cut on drawn cards, what the other side is told, and a blind switch

Max, 03:12 to 03:21 UTC on 14 November: we may read opponents' cards better than will carry to play against people; build the
randomization in. x8_rollout.Seats: `other` (the seats of the side that is not deciding take their cards by their own mode,
power and cut), `cut` (a drawn card is at least that share as likely as the likeliest), `seen` (the name the other side is
told for the deciding side's bot). Stage: cut, seat_other, power_other, cut_other. x8 `blind`: every setting keyed by the
opponent's id takes its '*' value; names 'they_see'. With none of these set the cards and the pinned settings are unchanged.
draw_regret.py: draws with a cut.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01N2EvxDPjdoFBFtyygdYP4j

scope: Max-directed Stu opponent-style, blind/split-seat, randomization, calibration and one-net/BEN200 research jobs on Azure2/3/5.
disposition: New style fields, cut/power modes and blind/name settings are opt-in research behavior. Commit notes explicitly retain unchanged pins for bots without them. The canonical owned plan/source has not adopted them; changes here would require new authority, a drained successor/new identity, complete exclusions and actual capture validation. Max04:17 schedules Stu's style calibration and later policy-v4.1/BEN200 measurements on those boxes; no local queue or model change.
